proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h : b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 := by linear_combination (-4 * a) * hx
    rw [h]
    exact sq_nonneg _
  · intro hD
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hD
    generalize Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) = s at hs
    refine ⟨(-b + s) / (2 * a), ?_⟩
    have hx : 2 * a * ((-b + s) / (2 * a)) = -b + s := by field_simp
    generalize (-b + s) / (2 * a) = x at hx ⊢
    have h1 : (4 * a) * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (2 * a * x + b + s) * hx + hs
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha)
